hub_notification_kinds.title: A task is given or handed to me
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: The moment someone makes a task for you or moves one to you: on a team page, from a meeting (the transcript names you), or by the Hub itself (a photographer to book, a recap to write).
hub_notification_kinds.says: The task, its team and project, the due date, who gave it, the first lines of its description, and a link that opens the task.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Call Oberoi about the Oct 18 event: food, number of volunteers, arrival time. Marketing, due Fri 17 Oct, from Ian. "Confirm the headcount and the 11:30 arrival; ask whether they bring the cooler."

hub_notification_kinds.title: My tasks due today, tomorrow or overdue
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: Weekday mornings at 8:30, once a day, when you have a task due today or tomorrow; on Mondays also when you only have overdue ones (the last 60 days).
hub_notification_kinds.says: Each task with its team, its due date and the first line of its description, in three lists: due today, overdue, due tomorrow; then a link to My page to close them or move the dates.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Due today (2): Call Oberoi about the Oct 18 event (Marketing). Decide with Suro on inventory (Operations Montreal). Due tomorrow (1): Follow up with Vatsala (HR). Close them or move the dates in the Hub.

hub_notification_kinds.title: A request is filed for my team
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When someone files a request that lands with you: it is assigned to you, its type goes to you by default, or you lead the team it is for.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The request and its type, who asked, when it is needed, the details they wrote, and a link to the Requests page.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Volunteer appreciation stickers (Marketing), from Soraya, needed by Fri 24 Oct. "50 stickers with the new logo for the Oct 26 serving; the printer needs the file by Tuesday."
hub_notification_kinds.audience: the person it is assigned to, else the team’s leads

hub_notification_kinds.title: A meeting suggestion becomes a request for my team
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When a request the Hub suggested from a meeting transcript is accepted into a real request that lands with you.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The request, the meeting it came from and the sentence that raised it, and a link to the Requests page.
hub_notification_kinds.example_title: A meeting suggestion is now a request
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Order the Rally Paper banners (Fundraising), from the 14 Oct marketing meeting: "we need the two banners before the Concordia tabling".
hub_notification_kinds.audience: the person it is assigned to

hub_notification_kinds.title: A request I asked for is done, or someone adds a note to it
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When a request you filed is marked done, and when someone adds a note on it (the person it is assigned to hears about notes too).
hub_notification_kinds.says: The request, who did it or wrote the note, the note itself, and a link to the request.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Your request "Volunteer appreciation stickers" to Marketing is done (Eduardo).
hub_notification_kinds.audience: the person who asked, and the person assigned

hub_notification_kinds.title: An email to info@ is passed on to me
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When an email to info@welfareavenue.com (or one sent on to a team) is for you: the Hub reads it and passes it on, unless someone on the team is already on the email.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who wrote, the subject, the gist in a few lines, and a link to the email in the Hub inbox.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: From Oberoi Financial Group: "Oct 18 volunteer day: parking and arrival". They ask where the team parks and confirm 12 volunteers.

hub_notification_kinds.title: A meeting mentions me
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: After a meeting transcript is processed and the meeting names you with something to do or know. Never from a one-on-one or a private meeting; a leadership meeting names the meeting without the sentence.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The meeting and its date, the sentence that mentions you, and a link to My page.
hub_notification_kinds.example_title: You were mentioned in a meeting
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Marketing meeting (14 Oct): "Ian will find a photographer for the Oberoi event and send the album link to Roberto."

hub_notification_kinds.title: Someone @mentions me in the Hub
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When someone writes @you in a comment, a task description, a request note, a goal or a project in the Hub. On Slack it arrives as a message from the writer when they connected Slack, else from the Hub with their name.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Their words around the mention and where it is, with a link that opens it. A confidential item is named without its text.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: On the task "Book a photographer for the serving on Saturday 18 October": "@Roberto can you bring the second camera and shoot the arrival?"

hub_notification_kinds.title: Content Studio: a post waits for my approval, is decided, or is mine to post by hand
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When a post is scheduled for approval (the approvers hear with Approve and Send it back buttons), when your post is approved or sent back, at the time of a post the Hub cannot post itself (LinkedIn articles, TikTok photos: you post it and press Mark posted), and the Monday link pages digest for publishers.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who sent what, the platforms and the time, the note, the Canva link, and the buttons or the link into the Studio.
hub_notification_kinds.example_title: A post waits for your approval
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Roberto sent a post for approval: "Oberoi volunteer day, the recap" (Instagram, LinkedIn, Sun Oct 19 6:00 p.m.). Approve · Send it back · Open the Studio.
hub_notification_kinds.audience: the approvers, the publishers and the post’s owner

hub_notification_kinds.title: A photographer or videographer applies
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When a volunteer applies as a photographer or videographer (the website form, CABM, Je Bénévole, by hand). It goes to the owner of the Volunteer Photographers step in the serving SOP.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who applied, as what, where from, their message, and a link to Applicants received.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Amina Osei applied as a photographer (the website), also as a server: "I shoot events on weekends and can come to the Oct 26 serving."
hub_notification_kinds.audience: the owner of the photographer step

hub_notification_kinds.title: Someone asks for time off
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: The moment a team member asks for time off on their My page or the Requests page. It goes to the HR notify list (Valex and Samson). Practice requests from the Academy never send it.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who asks, the dates and the number of days, the type, their note, and a link to Time off in the HR centre.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Joy asks for vacation, Mon 3 to Fri 7 Nov (5 days): "Family visit; the content calendar is scheduled through the week." Decide it in the HR centre.

hub_notification_kinds.title: An applicant I handle moves stage
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When an application card you handle moves to Interview, Offer or Hired, or is closed after an interview, by someone else. The HR channel hears every move; this is your own copy.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The applicant and the role, the stage and the interview time, who moved it, and a link to the Applications board.
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Vatsala Godi (Operations Co-Lead) moved to Interview (Tue Oct 21, 2:00 p.m.) by Samson. You handle this applicant.

hub_notification_kinds.title: Still in? after three hours in the Loop
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When your Loop session has run for three hours with no sign of life (the Hub asked under the button at one hour, then every half hour). One message per session, never a second one.
hub_notification_kinds.says: How long you have been in, and the links: still in, or close the loop (nothing changes your hours without an answer).
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: You have been in the Loop since 9:15 (3 hours). Still in? Or close the loop. Nothing changes your hours until you answer.

hub_notification_kinds.title: A new announcement for me
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When someone posts an announcement for everyone or for your team. Its Slack post in the team channel and its email are sent once regardless; this is the Hub notification.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who posted, the title and the first line, and a link that opens it (a poll or a short form opens on its question).
hub_notification_kinds.example_body: Oct 18 Oberoi volunteer day: meeting point, times and who brings what. Open it to see the plan.

hub_notification_kinds.title: The daily alerts
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: Every morning at 9:00 in the dashboard channel: tasks that passed their due date yesterday, tasks a week overdue, decisions open for 14 and 30 days. Open work only.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Each item with its team and owner, as a link into the Hub.

hub_notification_kinds.title: The weekly digest
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: Mondays in the dashboard channel: what each team moved last week, what is due this week, the decisions waiting. Open work only.
hub_notification_kinds.says: A section per team with counts and the top items.

hub_notification_kinds.title: Shout-outs
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: Daily, the work people closed and the thank-yous posted in the Hub, on the loading screen and in Slack.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who did what, in a line.

hub_notification_kinds.title: Applications and time off in #human-resources
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: Every applicant card that moves to Interview, Offer or Hired, and the offer letters sent, as a line in the HR channel.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The applicant, the role, the stage and who moved it.

hub_notification_kinds.title: Posts that went out, in #social-media
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When the Content Studio publishes a post (or sees one posted by hand in the analytics), a confirmation with the links, when the Studio setting is on.
hub_notification_kinds.says: The post, each platform it went to, and the link to open it.

hub_notification_kinds.title: The Loop in #check-in-out-wa
hub_notification_kinds.blurb: When someone presses I’m in and when they close the loop: one line each, with what moved; never hours, times or a private task’s title.
hub_notification_kinds.says: Who is in, who closed the loop and what they moved.
